description: Source code implementing parsing and serialization for structured HTTP headers as defined in RFC8941 and draft-ietf-httpbis-header-structure-09, including classes for parsing, serializing, and managing structured header data types.

classes.name: StructuredHeaderParser
classes.description: Parser class for reading structured header data types from strings, supporting draft-09 and RFC8941 formats.

classes.name: StructuredHeaderSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class for converting structured header data types into string representations, supporting RFC8941.

methods.name: FinishParsing
methods.description: Checks if the parser has successfully consumed all input after parsing.

methods.name: ReadListOfLists
methods.description: Parses a list of lists from the input string (draft-09 only).

methods.name: ReadList
methods.description: Parses a list of parameters or items (RFC8941).

methods.name: ReadItem
methods.description: Parses a parameterized item from the input string.

methods.name: ReadBareItem
methods.description: Parses a basic item (string, token, number, boolean, byte sequence) from the input string.

methods.name: ReadDictionary
methods.description: Parses a dictionary of key-value pairs (RFC8941).

methods.name: ReadParameterisedList
methods.description: Parses a list of parameterized identifiers (draft-09).

methods.name: ReadParameterisedIdentifier
methods.description: Parses a parameterized identifier with optional parameters (draft-09).

methods.name: ReadItemOrInnerList
methods.description: Parses either an item or an inner list.

methods.name: ReadParameters
methods.description: Parses parameters associated with items or inner lists.

methods.name: ReadInnerList
methods.description: Parses an inner list of items.

methods.name: ReadKey
methods.description: Parses a key string for dictionary entries.

methods.name: ReadToken
methods.description: Parses a token string.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Parses a numeric value (integer or decimal).

methods.name: ReadString
methods.description: Parses a quoted string.

methods.name: ReadByteSequence
methods.description: Parses a base64-encoded byte sequence.

methods.name: ReadBoolean
methods.description: Parses a boolean value.

methods.name: SkipWhitespaces
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters based on draft version.

methods.name: SkipOWS
methods.description: Skips optional whitespace.

methods.name: ConsumeChar
methods.description: Consumes a specific character if present.

methods.name: LogParseError
methods.description: Logs a parse error message.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Returns the serialized string output.

methods.name: WriteList
methods.description: Serializes a list of parameterized items.

methods.name: WriteItem
methods.description: Serializes a parameterized item.

methods.name: WriteBareItem
methods.description: Serializes a basic item (string, token, number, boolean, byte sequence).

methods.name: WriteDictionary
methods.description: Serializes a dictionary of key-value pairs.

methods.name: WriteParameterizedMember
methods.description: Serializes a parameterized member, which may be an inner list or a single item.

methods.name: WriteInnerList
methods.description: Serializes an inner list of items.

methods.name: WriteParameters
methods.description: Serializes parameters associated with items or inner lists.

methods.name: WriteKey
methods.description: Serializes a key string.
